title: Leader and Follower Mirror
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robotics
description: Six scenarios in which you predict where a follower arm's joint ends up when it copies a leader arm, stops at its own joint limits, and adds any calibration error. Afterwards, a free mode lets you move the leader's shoulder pan, elbow flex and wrist roll. Used in Chapter 2.

educational.topic: Leader and follower arms, joint limits and calibration error
learningObjectives: Infer the follower arm's joint angle from the leader's angle, the follower's joint limits, and its calibration error, in six scenarios, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict before the follower moves, then watch it confirm or correct the prediction
keyQuestions: Is the leader's angle inside the follower's limits?
Is the follower calibrated the same way as the leader?
commonMisconceptions: The follower always matches the leader exactly
Calibration does not affect the copy
The follower works out where the hand should go
assessmentOpportunities: Six committed angle choices; 5 of 6 for mastery
